summary: No installer-harm indicators observed in agentenact@0.2.0
details: Review of agentenact@0.2.0 (npm) surfaced no evidence of credential theft, install-time or import-time remote code execution, silent-relay of caller data to a non-first-party destination, backdoor, dropper behavior, or self-propagation. No lifecycle hooks fetching or executing remote content, no reads of installer-secret paths (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser or wallet stores), no whole-environment scraping, and no hardcoded attacker C2 endpoints were observed in the package's shipped files.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
